blind.description: A full suit of stylized medieval plate armor displayed on a wooden stand. The armor consists of an enclosed helmet with visor and crest, curved pauldrons, breastplate, faulds/tassets, gauntlets, greaves, and pointed sabatons. The armor is mounted on a central wooden post supported by a four-legged cross-shaped wooden base on the floor. Surfaces are clean, continuous, and stylized, finished in dark gunmetal/steel with warm gold trim and brown timber for the stand.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it displays the rounded shoulders and wide pauldrons flanking a central domed helmet with a prominent gold central stripe, the pointed ridge of the breastplate projecting slightly forward, and portions of the cruciform wooden stand visible underneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 to 5.0 feet tall (reaching roughly to the neck/shoulder level of the 5 ft 9 in reference figure) and about 2 feet wide across the pauldrons.
